Reduce Risk. Maximize your security ROI with the help of our experts. Talk to an expert Key Outcomes The Claroty CPS Protection Program Explore Resources As attackers increasingly target cyber-physical systems (CPS), organizations are finding themselves in a race against time to secure their environments. Because traditional IT strategies often fail to address the unique complexities of these environments, security teams need to use a holistic, programmatic approach to stay one step ahead of incidents. By building a mature CPS protection program, your organization can effectively reduce risk, ensure operational integrity, and maintain regulatory compliance through a strategy that's tailor-made to fit your specific infrastructure. Purchasing Tech Alone Doesn’t Drive Outcomes Simply adding to your existing tech stack doesn’t solve your business goals. Key barriers need to be broken to get there, including: Lack of clear ownership between IT, security, and asset owners. No standard procedures or handoff points between all teams Inability to translate security technology into outcomes, risking budget reallocation Pillars of Operationalization An operationalized program is a coordinated, repeatable system where people, processes, and technology work in harmony to reduce real risk. Establish clear ownership and a unified security language Enable teams to transition from ad-hoc responses to documented, repeatable workflows Leverage the Claroty Platform to drive execution and reach business outcomes Key Outcomes Successfully putting CPS protection into practice with a programmatic approach will help your organization reach three critical security outcomes: CPS Risk Reduction Reduce the attack surface and risk exposure across their enterprise, diminishing the likelihood of a cyber incident causing downtime and financial loss. Compliance Meet and prove compliance within an increasingly complex regulatory landscape as these frameworks become more industry-specific and CPS-focused. Operational Integrity Protect operational uptime, availability of equipment, and public safety while ensuring the delivery of critical services. The Claroty CPS Protection Program From guiding customers through creating standard operating procedures to conducting regular risk assessments, Claroty has the industry knowledge and solutions to reach these critical business outcomes, helping your organization maximize its CPS security ROI. Claroty’s CPS Protection Program uses a combination of people, processes, and technology to reduce CPS risk, total cost of ownership (TCO), and mean time to repair (MTTR).
